raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / NUOVO QUADRILOCALE - FRONTE MARE A JESOLO NEW DEVELOPMENT · APARTMENT Nuovo Quadrilocale - Fronte mare a Jesolo PIAZZA TORINO · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €357,000 Photos (36) Floor plans (0) 1 / 36 FLOOR AREA 100 m² BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT Yes ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo Lido! This exclusive newly built four-room apartment is located on the fourth floor of the prestigious W-ONE residence, in the heart of Jesolo Lido. Characterized by maximum efficiency with Energy Class A4, the property (Unit U15) offers spacious areas ideal for families or those seeking maximum comfort, distributed across a bright open-plan living area, three cozy bedrooms, two carefully finished bathrooms, and a beautiful livable terrace. The property also includes a private parking space and reserved beach spot. - Spaces of the Four-Room Apartment and Livable Terrace The living area stands out for its extraordinary brightness and harmoniously blends with the large livable terrace, creating an ideal environment for outdoor dining and moments of pure relaxation enhanced by being on the fifth floor. The sleeping area has been meticulously designed to offer comfort and privacy, consisting of three comfortable bedrooms and two contemporary-designed bathrooms created to best meet daily needs. - Exclusive Services of the Residence Living in W-ONE means accessing an experience of superior comfort. Outside there is a large communal swimming pool perfect for summer days while inside there is a fully equipped gym accessible 24 hours a day. The private parking space and reserved beach spot ensure you enjoy the summer season in total privacy and convenience with the sea just steps away from home. - Benefits and Purchase Services The investment becomes even more advantageous thanks to Sisma Bonus Purchases, with the proposed price already calculated net of tax benefits. For those looking for a tailored solution, our interior designers are available to define materials and finishes personalizing your home according to your style. Additionally, if you need to sell your current property we manage all exchanges taking care to enhance your property making transitioning into your new home simple and worry-free. Live by the sea; finally at home!
